fields.name: decimals
docs: @dev number of decimals for the fToken, same as ASSET

fields.name: rewardsRateModel
docs: @dev To read PDA of rewards rate model to get_rate instruction

fields.name: liquidityExchangePrice
docs: @dev exchange price for the underlying asset in the liquidity protocol (without rewards)

fields.name: tokenExchangePrice
docs: @dev exchange price between fToken and the underlying asset (with rewards)

fields.name: lastUpdateTimestamp
docs: @dev timestamp when exchange prices were updated the last time

fields.name: mint
docs: @dev mint address

fields.name: startTvl
docs: @dev tvl below which rewards rate is 0. If current TVL is below this value, triggering `update_rate()` on the fToken
might bring the total TVL above this cut-off.

fields.name: duration
docs: @dev for how long current rewards should run

fields.name: startTime
docs: @dev when current rewards got started

fields.name: yearlyReward
docs: @dev current annualized reward based on input params (duration, rewardAmount)

fields.name: nextDuration
docs: @dev Duration for the next rewards phase

fields.name: nextRewardAmount
docs: @dev Amount of rewards for the next phase

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} deposits ${data.assets} of ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.depositorTokenAccount} to earn, receiving ${accounts.fTokenMint} shares in ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}

${accounts.signer} deposits ${data.assets} of ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.depositorTokenAccount} to earn, receiving at least ${data.minAmountOut} of ${accounts.fTokenMint} in ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}
${accounts.signer} opens an Earn market for ${accounts.mint} with jlToken mint ${accounts.fTokenMint} and symbol ${data.symbol}
${accounts.authority} sets up Earn with authority ${data.authority}, rebalancer ${data.rebalancer} and liquidity program ${data.liquidityProgram}
${accounts.signer} deposits ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.depositorTokenAccount} to receive ${data.shares} of ${accounts.fTokenMint} in ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}

${accounts.signer} deposits at most ${data.maxAssets} of ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.depositorTokenAccount} to receive ${data.shares} of ${accounts.fTokenMint} in ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}
${accounts.signer} redeems ${data.shares} of ${accounts.fTokenMint} from ${accounts.ownerTokenAccount} for ${accounts.mint}, paid to ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}
${accounts.signer} redeems ${data.shares} of ${accounts.fTokenMint} from ${accounts.ownerTokenAccount} for at least ${data.minAmountOut} of ${accounts.mint}, paid to ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}
${accounts.signer} sets the rewards rate model of ${accounts.lending} to ${accounts.newRewardsRateModel}
${accounts.signer} updates the list of Earn auths
Updates the exchange prices of Earn market ${accounts.lending}
${accounts.signer} withdraws ${data.amount} of ${accounts.mint} to ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}, paying with ${accounts.fTokenMint} shares from ${accounts.ownerTokenAccount}
${accounts.signer} withdraws ${data.amount} of ${accounts.mint} to ${accounts.recipientTokenAccount}, paying with ${accounts.fTokenMint} shares from ${accounts.ownerTokenAccount}
